title: Preoperative Score of Inguinal Hernias. Is it Useful to Predict Outcomes
brief_summary: To analyze and validate a preoperative score of difficulty of inguinal hernias and its correlation with postoperative outcomes
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male sex
* Age \> 18 years
* Primary inguinal hernia
* Unilateral hernia
* Elective surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Recurrent inguinal hernia
study_population: All patients scheduled for a primary repair of inguinal hernia
